purpose: Configurable copy preflight that detects some failure modes but cannot certify good writing or factual accuracy.

soft: at the end of the day
take your business to the next level
innovation is the key to success

claim_rule: Pattern matches request review. They do not prove a factual claim is unsupported; many claims are not detected.
visual_rule: Social copy needs a real inspected asset. Text cannot prove pixels, provenance, crop, privacy or a platform label. Missing or unchecked assets block publication.
human_review: Is the point useful to the intended reader?
Is each factual claim supported by an original source?
Does the actual visual add proof without private information?
Does the wording sound natural for this author?
scope: Preflight only. Does not schedule, publish, check duplicates, validate external links, review design pixels, or assert AI-origin detection.

grammar.rhetorical_setup: An abstract setup ending in “one test/one question/one thing:” followed by a rhetorical question is blocked.
grammar.question_if_verdict: A standalone question followed by “If ..., it is ...” is blocked as a punchline template.
grammar.if_then_aphorism: A short standalone “If ..., it is ...” sentence is reviewed, not automatically blocked.
grammar.fragment_stack: Three or more very short sentence-fragment lines in a social post invite review; do not penalize simple list items.
grammar.false_contrast: Not X, but Y / not just X but also Y constructions are flagged.
grammar.rule_of_three: Three adjacent similarly phrased short lines are reviewed, not every three-item list.
grammar.em_dash_pivot: A clause with an em dash pivot is reviewed.
grammar.scope: Grammar patterns are fingerprints, not proof of AI authorship. Report spans and edit advice; human voice review remains mandatory.
